candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Rotation-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the hips bob/lunge/flop, peel pop/slide, chip flip/drop, loot tip, loot-chips jump/spill and brow raise are the intentional translations. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof (the Blender attachment audit covers listed part pairs).
note: glTF axes: +Y up, character faces -Z; its right side is +X. Root at the floor origin between the feet, 1.8 cm in front of the egg body centre.
